mentions.note: 1932-2000; died 15th December 2000 aged 68; born Springburn, Glasgow; won Belgrave 5 3/4 road trial March 1961; 6th fastest stage 9 London to Brighton Relay 1962; AAA vest 1962; Middlesex track champion; 6th Scottish National cross country 1963

share.d: W.E. Kerr in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 2001: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
